categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in stainless steel coil surface treatment, slitting, cutting, and precision rolling. Its main products are various stainless steel coils and sheets, serving industries such as electronics (3C products), automotive, environmental energy, home appliances, button batteries, and construction engineering. It also operates subsidiaries involved in stainless steel processing and investment activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature production technologies including ultra-thin precision stainless steel manufacturing, surface treatment, slitting, cutting, and precision rolling. It continuously improves processing techniques to develop functional stainless steel sheets tailored to customer needs, focusing on high value-added products like automotive trim, electronic components, and energy/environmental battery applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span electronics, automotive, environmental energy, home appliance, button battery, and construction sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant export ratio of 60-70%, targeting regions including Asia (excluding Taiwan), the Americas, and Taiwan itself.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and a subsidiary in Ningbo, China. Sales markets cover Asia (excluding Taiwan), the Americas, and Taiwan, with efforts to expand into emerging countries and diversify sales channels internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the stainless steel supply chain, focusing on processing and value-added manufacturing of stainless steel coils and sheets. It sources raw stainless steel coils from upstream suppliers and supplies processed products to downstream industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing new markets and products to diversify sales risk and enhance profitability, improving production efficiency and quality, and reducing operational costs. R&D focuses on ultra-thin titanium alloy and nickel-based alloy sheets, high-performance and high-margin product lines, and green, low-carbon manufacturing aligned with global sustainability trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of processed stainless steel coils and sheets. The company also derives income from its subsidiaries engaged in stainless steel processing and investment activities. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major domestic competitors include Jianquan (5014), Zhangyuan (2030), and Xinguang (2032), with the company holding a domestic market share of approximately 8.57% in stainless steel coil sales. The market is fragmented with many small to medium players, but the company leverages scale, technology, and integrated Taiwan-China resources to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net revenues of approximately NT$10.7 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 9.5% decrease from the prior year, but with improved gross and net profit margins. Total assets were about NT$9.17 billion with equity of NT$4 billion. The company has shown a recovery from prior losses to profitability and plans to increase sales volume by about 12% in the coming year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision-processed stainless steel products with advanced ultra-thin manufacturing capabilities. It differentiates through product innovation tailored to high-growth sectors like electronics and automotive, strong supplier relationships ensuring stable raw material supply, and integrated Taiwan-China operations to optimize cost and service. Commitment to sustainability and green manufacturing further enhances its competitive edge.
